en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural or small‑town landscape with scattered houses, trees, and low hills or mountains in the background. In the foreground there appears to be an open sandy or dirt area, possibly a riverbank or road. The image is framed with a white border. Below the photograph there are captions printed in Greek and French, and at the lower right is the printed URL 'www.elia.org.gr'. A round stamp or logo appears in the lower left corner of the image area.
